privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains what information Audiogram collects, how it is used, and how it is protected.
privacy.section1Body: Audiogram is a local-first application. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data to external servers. All your music files, playlists, and preferences remain exclusively on your device.
privacy.section2Body: The application stores your library metadata, playback preferences, equalizer settings, and playlist configurations locally in an on-device database. This data never leaves your device and is not accessible to us.
privacy.section3Body: Audiogram may connect to the internet solely to check for application updates from our GitHub releases page. No usage data, music metadata, or personal information is sent during this process.
privacy.section4Body: Audiogram does not integrate with any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services. Links within the app (such as GitHub or Telegram) open in your browser and are subject to those platforms' own privacy policies.
privacy.section5Body: Since all data is stored locally on your device, its security depends on your device's own security measures. We recommend keeping your operating system and Audiogram updated to the latest version.
privacy.section6Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected in updated application releases. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
